tickets.summary: PSV-3420’s certification tag is illegible, but the register shows March 2025 recertification and no valve defect or protection loss was observed.
tickets.recommended_action: Replace the tag under authorized PSV certification control; verify valve identity and March 2025 certificate.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: An illegible tag does not indicate near-term loss of relief function; the valve was recently recertified, is reported in date and has no observed physical defect.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of this non-redundant safety-critical PSV would remove compressor-discharge overpressure protection, creating extreme major-accident exposure.

urgency.rationale: triage-policy-v2: ceil(0.7*I+0.3*L), L=1, I=9, base=7, final=7. R-SCE (review): SCE draft requires integrity-engineer review; no automatic urgency floor. Sources: registry SCE flag.

tickets.review_reason: R-SCE (review): SCE draft requires integrity-engineer review; no automatic urgency floor. Sources: registry SCE flag.
